name: meerkads
description: Read your Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Shopify, GA4 and Search Console performance from Meerkads.

interface.longDescription: Ask about the ad accounts and store connected to your Meerkads workspace: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Shopify, GA4 and Search Console. Compare periods, find top and wasted spend, spot anomalies and creative fatigue, and get budget scenarios. Meerkads is read-only: it never changes campaigns, budgets or settings, and it only reads the workspace you authorize.
capabilities: Top and worst campaigns, ads and keywords
defaultPrompt: How did my ads perform across all channels in the last 30 days?
Compare this month's Meta results with last month.
Which Google Ads campaigns are wasting the most spend?

positive.description: Cross-channel summary for the connected workspace
positive.prompt: How did my ads perform across all channels in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns spend, clicks, conversions and revenue per connected channel with blended totals for the last 30 days. Missing values are shown as unavailable, never as zero.

positive.prompt: Compare this month's Meta Ads results with last month.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows current vs previous period values and the change for Meta spend, conversions, CPA and ROAS.

positive.prompt: What are my top 5 Google Ads campaigns by conversions this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists five Google Ads campaigns ranked by conversions with spend and CPA for each.

positive.prompt: Where am I wasting ad spend in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists campaigns, ads or search terms that spent money without conversions, with the amount spent on each.

positive.prompt: Were there any unusual spikes or drops in my ad performance last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the days and metrics that moved unusually, with the size of the change, or says that nothing unusual was found.

negative.prompt: Pause my worst performing Meta campaign.
Increase my Google Ads daily budget to $500.
Show me the ad performance of a competitor's account.

review.commerce_description: Meerkads does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only performance insights across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Shopify, GA4 and Search Console.

tr-TR.subtitle: Reklam ve mağaza performansı
tr-TR.description: Meerkads çalışma alanınıza bağlı Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Shopify, GA4 ve Search Console verilerinizi sorun: dönemleri karşılaştırın, en iyi ve boşa giden harcamayı bulun, anomalileri ve kreatif yorgunluğunu görün, bütçe senaryoları alın. Meerkads yalnızca okur; kampanya, bütçe veya ayar değiştirmez ve sadece yetki verdiğiniz çalışma alanını okur.
